description: The gravel hub: members, HTTP and API traffic, logins, backups, the servers it polls, its background jobs and the Go runtime (gravel docs/hub.md, Observability).

panels.description: No data is expected when no login provider is configured (auth).
panels.gravelOptional: no login provider is configured (auth)
panels.title: Linked identities

panels.description: 0 when the database did not answer the scrape's count queries in time.
panels.title: Counts readable

panels.description: No data is expected when no login provider is configured (auth).
panels.gravelOptional: no login provider is configured (auth)
panels.title: Linked identities over time

targets.expr: (sum by (handler) (rate(gravel_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (handler) (rate(gravel_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (handler) (rate(gravel_http_requests_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Includes the pages' in-process calls (ADR-0005).
panels.title: Calls by procedure

panels.description: No data is expected when no call has failed in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no call has failed in the range
panels.title: Errors by procedure and code

panels.description: No data is expected when nobody logged in or linked in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody logged in or linked in the range
panels.title: Login, link and Linked Roles attempts

panels.description: No data is expected when no request was rate limited in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no request was rate limited in the range
panels.title: Refused by a rate limit

panels.description: Red after 26 hours: the nightly backup missed a night. No data is expected when backups are not configured (backup.status_file) or none has succeeded yet.
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured (backup.status_file) or none has succeeded yet
panels.title: Since the last base backup

panels.description: No data is expected when backups are not configured or have never run.
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured or have never run
panels.title: Since the last run

panels.description: No data is expected when backups are not configured or have never run.
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured or have never run
panels.title: Last run succeeded

panels.description: No data is expected when backups are not configured (backup.status_file is empty).
panels.gravelOptional: backups are not configured (backup.status_file is empty)
panels.title: Status file readable

panels.description: Red after 10 minutes: the archive trails the database by more than archive_timeout allows. No data is expected when WAL archiving is off or has archived nothing yet.
panels.gravelOptional: WAL archiving is off or has archived nothing yet
panels.title: Since the last WAL segment archived

panels.description: No data is expected when WAL archiving is off.
panels.gravelOptional: WAL archiving is off
panels.title: WAL segments archived

panels.description: No data is expected when no WAL upload has ever failed.
panels.gravelOptional: no WAL upload has ever failed
panels.title: Since the last WAL failure

panels.description: Down after two failed polls in a row (ADR-0010); the hub's log says why. No data is expected when no server is registered (servers.yaml).
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered (servers.yaml)
panels.title: Reachable

panels.description: No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Since the last good poll

panels.description: No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Players now

panels.description: The max line is the public slots (War Dogs: MaxPlayers less MaxReservedSlots). No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Players over time

panels.description: The build each server runs, as the watcher last read it (every minute, ADR-0010). No data is expected when no server is registered, or none has answered yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server is registered, or none has answered yet
panels.title: Build

panels.description: A game update: the watcher read a new build and the capabilities again. Re-record the fixtures (games/wardogs/README.md). No data is expected when no server changed build in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no server changed build in the range
panels.title: Build changes

panels.description: Kicks, bans, messages and moves the hub sent, by outcome; each is a row in the audit log (ListAuditLog). No data is expected when no moderation call was made in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no moderation call was made in the range
panels.title: Moderation calls

panels.description: Matches the stats store started from the polls (ADR-0012): a rotation, every counter dropping, or the first player on an empty server. No data is expected when no match was played in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: no match was played in the range
panels.title: Matches recorded

panels.description: One row per player on a server per good poll. No data is expected when nobody was on a server in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nobody was on a server in the range
panels.title: Player rows written

panels.description: The stats store could not write a poll (the database); the next poll records from the store, so only that poll's time on is lost. No data is expected when every poll was recorded in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: every poll was recorded in the range
panels.title: Polls not recorded

panels.description: Per-match player rows past stats.raw_retention_months, moved into monthly totals and deleted (ADR-0012 §6). Boards keep their numbers.
panels.title: Rows rolled up

panels.description: The rollup job runs every 6 hours; much over that means it is failing (gravel_hub_jobs_total, result error). Prometheus stores the runner's job label as exported_job, since the scrape's own job label wins.
panels.title: Since the last rollup

panels.description: A feed posts only while players fight, so a quiet server is quiet here too; compare with Players now (ADR-0011). No data is expected when no server has a feed (servers.yaml feed), or none has posted yet.
panels.gravelOptional: no server has a feed (servers.yaml feed), or none has posted yet
panels.title: Since the last batch

panels.description: stored: kept before the answer; unauthorized: no valid feed token (server unknown); rate_limited, too_large, bad_request: refused; error: not stored, so lost (the sources do not retry). No data is expected when nothing posted to the ingest route in the range.
panels.gravelOptional: nothing posted to the ingest route in the range
panels.title: Ingest requests by result

panels.description: A failed run is retried with backoff and never stops the hub; server_poll failures are a server that did not answer.
panels.title: Job runs by result

panels.description: prune runs every 10 minutes, servers_reconcile and ingest_feeds every 30 seconds, ingest_prune hourly, server_poll at each server's interval.
panels.title: Since each job last succeeded

title: gravel hub
